req.title: Register form html served
req.statement: The system shall include HTML input fields named 'username' and 'password' in the /auth/register page.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-027 requires that GET /auth/register returns an HTTP 2xx response containing HTML input fields named 'username' and 'password'. Three tests are designed: (1) a positive EP test verifying the exact status code 200 and presence of both named input fields in the response body; (2) a negative NEG test verifying that a wrong path (e.g. /auth/register-typo) returns 404, not 200, confirming the route is specifically bound; (3) a boundary BVA test verifying the exact byte-level HTML attributes 'name="username"' and 'name="password"' appear in the response, catching mutations that alter field names or omit them. Together these tests kill constant-mutation, string-mutation, status-code-flip, and field-name-mutation operators.

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_get_returns_200_with_username_and_password_fields():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.test_client() as client:
        r = client.get('/auth/register')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert b'name="username"' in r.data
        assert b'name="password"' in r.data

test_register_get_returns_200_with_username_and_password_fields()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_wrong_register_path_returns_404_not_200():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.test_client() as client:
        r = client.get('/auth/register-typo')
        assert r.status_code == 404
        assert r.status_code != 200
        assert b'name="username"' not in r.data
        assert b'name="password"' not in r.data

test_wrong_register_path_returns_404_not_200()

tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

def test_register_form_field_names_are_exactly_username_and_password():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
    os.close(fd)
    app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
    with app.test_client() as client:
        r = client.get('/auth/register')
        assert r.status_code == 200
        assert b'name="username"' in r.data
        assert b'name="password"' in r.data
        assert b'name="user_name"' not in r.data
        assert b'name="passwd"' not in r.data
        assert b'name="user"' not in r.data
        assert b'name="pass"' not in r.data
        content_type = r.content_type
        assert 'text/html' in content_type

test_register_form_field_names_are_exactly_username_and_password()
